enum AppError: Error, Equatable {

    case staleData

    /// Safe, user-facing copy. Never includes the underlying message from

private struct ActionResultEnvelope: Decodable {
    let outcome: String?
    let result: String?
    let request: Request?
    let currentState: Request?
    let code: ActionConflictCode?
    let requestId: String?

        case .applied:
            guard let request else {
                throw NetworkError.malformedResponse

        case .conflict:
            guard let currentState, let code else {
                throw NetworkError.malformedResponse

        case .none:
            if normalized == "offline" {
                guard let requestId else { throw NetworkError.malformedResponse }
                return .offline(queuedActionId: requestId)
            }
            if let request {
                return .applied(updatedRequest: request)
            }
            throw NetworkError.malformedResponse
        }
    }

actor FileBackedOutboxStore: OutboxStore {
    private enum Constants {
        static let filename = "request_outbox.json"
        static let schemaVersion = 1
    }

    private let storageURL: URL
    private let encoder = JSONEncoder()
    private let decoder = JSONDecoder()

    init(directory: URL? = nil) throws {
        let base = directory ?? FileManager.default.urls(for: .applicationSupportDirectory, in: .userDomainMask).first!
        let folder = base.appendingPathComponent("PulseRelay", isDirectory: true)
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: folder, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        storageURL = folder.appendingPathComponent(Constants.filename)

        if !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: storageURL.path()) {
            try writePayload(OutboxEnvelope(version: Constants.schemaVersion, actions: []))
        }
    }

    func loadAll() async throws -> [OutboxAction] {
        return try readPayload().actions
    }

    func upsert(_ action: OutboxAction) async throws {
        var payload = try readPayload()
        if let index = payload.actions.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == action.id }) {
            payload.actions[index] = action
        } else {
            payload.actions.append(action)
        }
        try writePayload(payload)
    }

    func markResolved(_ id: String, status: OutboxStatus) async throws {
        var payload = try readPayload()
        guard let index = payload.actions.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == id }) else {
            return
        }
        payload.actions[index].status = status
        try writePayload(payload)
    }

    func drop(_ id: String) async throws {
        var payload = try readPayload()
        payload.actions.removeAll(where: { $0.id == id })
        try writePayload(payload)
    }

    func clearAllForSchemaReset() async throws {
        try writePayload(OutboxEnvelope(version: Constants.schemaVersion, actions: []))
    }

    private func readPayload() throws -> OutboxEnvelope {
        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: storageURL.path()) else {
            return OutboxEnvelope(version: Constants.schemaVersion, actions: [])
        }
        let data = try Data(contentsOf: storageURL)
        let payload = try decoder.decode(OutboxEnvelope.self, from: data)
        if payload.version != Constants.schemaVersion {
            throw OutboxStoreError.schemaMismatch
        }
        return payload
    }

    private func writePayload(_ payload: OutboxEnvelope) throws {
        let data = try encoder.encode(payload)
        try data.write(to: storageURL, options: .atomic)
    }
}

        }

            let podId = (userInfo["podId"] as? String) ?? ""

            return .success(PushPayload(requestId: requestId, podId: podId, eventType: eventType))
